_note: case-type-short-name: `shortName` is the case type's name where a line has room for a word or two, such as the week strip on Mijn werk (DqMijnWerk "2026-4837 · Woo"). Places that read it fall back to `title` when it is empty. caseType moves to 1.46.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema (renumber at merge if 1.46.0 is taken).

shortName.title: Short name
shortName.description: The case type's name in a word or two, for lines with little room, for example "Woo" for Woo-verzoek. Empty shows the title.
